_note: The reference sequence for the capital markets note template. Frame 1 is the mockup: eyebrow, two-tone serif headline, three-up metric row, WHAT CHANGED list, signal box, two-column footer. Every number here is illustrative and carries a source line - replace both before this goes anywhere near a post.

blocks.text: Rounds priced flat. The paper got heavier.

bullets: Structure appeared in 6 of 41 rounds, up from 2.
Median cheque flat; the change sits in the terms.
Two sectors took 60% of the total raised.
Bridges outnumbered priced rounds, third week running.
Secondaries stayed quiet - four transactions, all small.
One sector accounted for every down round this week.
Nothing in the week is a rates story.
frames.signal: Flat pricing with heavier structure is not a flat market. Read the terms, not the headline number.
frames.data_sources: s45 deal tracker, week to 26 Jul 2026. Full sources in caption.

blocks.text: Six of forty-one is not a trend. Six against two is the start of one.

chart.title: Rounds carrying structure
chart.source: s45 deal tracker, 380 disclosed private rounds to 30 June 2026.

frames.signal: The share has more than quadrupled in six quarters.

blocks.text: Structure is how an investor holds a valuation without believing it.
A preference stack, a ratchet and a participation right are all price.
None of them appear in the number a founder repeats at dinner.

chart.title: Founder proceeds, $100mn headline
chart.source: s45 illustrative model. Structure only, not a specific transaction.

blocks.text: If you are raising this quarter, model the exit at three outcomes, not one.
The term you skim is the one that decides what you keep.
